mock_data.title: Facing Angry Parents
mock_data.passage:
The local town hall was full of angry parents awaiting the arrival of Mr James, councillor in charge of recreational facilities in the town. They had hoped that some of the other councillors would appear, but Mr James arrived on his own, other councillors being conspicuous by their absence.

They were concerned about the lack of playground facilities in the town and were determined that something be done about this. Mr James was famous for his smooth talking, but the parents were determined that he would not get away with eloquence tonight. Tonight they would make the point that actions speak louder than words.

As the parents expected, Mr James immediately went on the charm offensive when he entered the hall. True to form, he had prepared a speech which said how much the children of the town meant to all the councillors and how concerned the councillors were about the welfare of the young, and he began to read from this. To his surprise, he had hardly got into his stride when he was interrupted by a man who suggested that he cut the cackle and get down to brass tacks. Mr James was appalled at the man's rudeness, but the other parents were on the side of the interrupter.

They were already up in arms about the lack of action on the part of the council and Mr James's smooth talking was simply adding fuel to the flames. Mr James had suspected that the parents would be a difficult audience to please, but he was getting more than he had bargained for.

Many of them had spent several years trying to get the provision of playground facilities improved and increased and they were quite determined to get their impatience and dissatisfaction off their chest. Mr James tried to point out that some improvements had been made in that existing equipment had been repaired. However, this was simply dismissed by the parents as too little, too late.

Mr James was absolutely exhausted by the time the parents had finished telling him exactly what was required if their children were to have safe and interesting places to play. He made a great many notes and he also made a mental note not to attend the next meeting on this subject. He would send his deputy.
mock_data.passageB1:
The town hall was crowded with angry parents. They were waiting for Mr. James, the councillor responsible for the town's parks and playgrounds. The parents were hoping that other councillors would be there too, but Mr. James was the only one who came. The other councillors were not present.

The parents were worried about the lack of good playgrounds in the town. They wanted the council to do something about it. Mr. James was known for being a good speaker, but the parents were determined that he would not just use nice words. They wanted real action, not just promises.

When Mr. James arrived, he started to be very friendly, just as the parents expected. He had a speech ready, saying how much the councillors cared about the children and their well-being. He started reading it. But before he could really begin, a man interrupted him. The man told him to get to the point quickly. Mr. James was shocked by this, but the other parents agreed with the man.

The parents were already angry because the council had not done anything. Mr. James's nice words were only making them angrier. Mr. James knew the parents would be difficult to satisfy, but it was even worse than he thought.

Many of them had been trying for years to get better playgrounds. They were eager to tell Mr. James how unhappy they were. Mr. James tried to say that they had made some small improvements, like fixing some of the old equipment. But the parents said it was not enough and had taken too long.

Mr. James was very tired after the parents told him exactly what they wanted for their children's playgrounds. He wrote down many notes. He also decided that he would not go to the next meeting about this. He would send his assistant instead. The parents wanted the council to take action and improve the situation.
mock_data.passageB2:
The town hall was brimming with angry parents, all waiting for Mr. James, the councillor responsible for the town’s recreational areas. They had hoped more councillors would attend, but Mr. James arrived alone, the others conspicuously absent. The parents were deeply unhappy about the lack of suitable playgrounds and were determined to see some action taken.

Mr. James was known for his persuasive manner, but the parents were resolved not to be swayed by empty promises. They wanted to make it clear that they expected results, not just words. They had been campaigning for better facilities for a long time.

As anticipated, Mr. James immediately tried to win them over with charm upon entering the hall. He began reading a prepared speech about how much the council valued the town's children and their well-being. However, he was quickly interrupted by a parent who, in no uncertain terms, told him to get to the point. Mr. James was taken aback by the man's directness, but the other parents clearly sided with the interrupter. They had run out of patience with the council's inaction, and Mr. James's smooth talk only made things worse.

Mr. James had expected a challenging audience, but the situation was even more difficult than he had imagined. Many of the parents had been trying to improve playground facilities for years and were determined to voice their frustrations. Mr. James attempted to point out that some repairs had been made to existing equipment. However, the parents dismissed this as insufficient and overdue. They felt like they were being fobbed off with excuses.

By the time the parents had finished explaining exactly what was needed to create safe and engaging play areas for their children, Mr. James was completely drained. He took detailed notes and secretly decided to send his deputy to the next meeting on the subject. He was completely overwhelmed by the level of anger and the sheer volume of complaints.
mock_data.passageC1:
The town hall seethed with palpable anger as parents, their patience wearing thin, awaited the arrival of Mr. James, the councillor tasked with overseeing the town's recreational facilities. The conspicuous absence of his colleagues only served to exacerbate the situation, reinforcing the parents' perception that their concerns were being dismissed.

Their grievance, the woefully inadequate provision of playground facilities, had reached a boiling point. Mr. James, known for his gift of the gab, was unlikely to quell their discontent with mere rhetoric. The parents were adamant that this meeting would transcend empty promises; they intended to underscore the imperative of tangible action.

Predictably, Mr. James initiated what could only be described as a full-fledged charm offensive upon entering the hall. True to form, he launched into a prepared speech, waxing lyrical about the council's purported dedication to the town's children and their well-being. However, he had barely found his rhythm when a dissenting voice, cutting through the platitudes, demanded he dispense with the pleasantries and address the core issue. Mr. James, clearly taken aback by what he perceived as impudence, found himself facing a united front of parental disapproval.

Their frustration, already simmering beneath the surface, was further inflamed by Mr. James's perceived evasiveness. He had anticipated a challenging audience, but the intensity of their collective ire was proving to be more than he had bargained for. Years of unheeded pleas for improved and expanded playground facilities had culminated in a collective determination to vent their pent-up frustration.

Mr. James's attempts to highlight minor improvements, such as the repair of existing equipment, were summarily rejected as insufficient and belated. The parents' demands were clear: safe, stimulating spaces for their children to play were not a luxury, but a necessity. By the time the parents had finished laying out their demands, Mr. James was utterly drained. He meticulously documented their requests and resolved, with unwavering certainty, to delegate attendance at the next meeting to his deputy, lest he face a repeat performance.

questions.answer: Based on the title and paragraphs, the passage is about Mr James, a councillor, facing angry parents at a meeting about recreational facilities. The parents are upset and confrontational. By the end, Mr James is exhausted from the difficult meeting and decides not to attend future meetings on this topic, choosing to send his deputy instead.
questions.question: Read the title above, the first and last paragraphs and say what you understand the passage to be about.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Students should describe: the situation that caused the anger, who was angry and why, how they handled the confrontation, their emotional response, whether the issue was resolved, and what they learned from the experience.
questions.question: Recall a time when you had to face someone who was angry.

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Common feelings when facing angry people include: nervousness, fear, anxiety, stress, defensiveness, frustration, guilt (if at fault), sympathy, desire to resolve the situation, feeling overwhelmed, wanting to escape, determination to stay calm.
questions.question: What were your feelings on that occasion?

mock_data.translation:
Mahalliy shahar hokimligi janob Jeyms, shahar ko'ngil ochar inshootlari uchun mas'ul bo'lgan kengash a'zosining kelishini kutayotgan g'azablangan ota-onalar bilan to'la edi. Ular boshqa kengash a'zolari paydo bo'ladi deb umid qilishgan, ammo janob Jeyms yolg'iz keldi, boshqa kengash a'zolari yo'qligi bilan ko'zga tashlanardi.

Ular shaharda o'yin maydonchalarining etishmasligi haqida tashvishlanishdi va bu haqda nimadir qilinishi kerakligini qat'iy talab qilishdilar. Janob Jeyms silliq gapirish bilan mashhur edi, ammo ota-onalar u bu kecha notiqlik bilan qutulmasligini qat'iy talab qilishdi. Bu kecha ular harakatlar so'zlardan ko'ra balandroq gapirishini isbotlamoqchi edilar.

Ota-onalar kutganidek, janob Jeyms zalga kirganida darhol maftunkor hujumga o'tdi. O'z odatiga sodiq, u shahar bolalari barcha kengash a'zolari uchun qanchalik muhimligini va kengash a'zolari yoshlarning farovonligi haqida qanchalik tashvishlanayotganini aytuvchi nutq tayyorlagan va undan o'qiy boshladi. Uning hayratiga qaramay, u zo'rg'a o'z ritmiiga kirganida bir kishi uni to'xtatib, gapni qisqartirib, asosiy masalaga o'tishni taklif qildi. Janob Jeyms odamning qo'polligidan dahshatga tushdi, ammo boshqa ota-onalar to'xtatuvchi tomonida edilar.

Ular allaqachon kengash tomonidan harakat yo'qligi haqida qo'lga qurol olgan edilar va janob Jeymsning silliq gapirishi shunchaki olovga benzin quyish edi. Janob Jeyms ota-onalar qanoatlantirish uchun qiyin auditoriya bo'lishini taxmin qilgan edi, ammo u kutganidan ko'ra ko'proq narsani olayotgan edi.

Ularning ko'pchiligi o'yin maydonchalarini yaxshilash va ko'paytirishga urinib bir necha yil sarflagan edilar va ular o'zlarining sabrsizligi va noroziliklarini ko'ksidan chiqarishga qat'iy qaror qilgan edilar. Janob Jeyms ba'zi yaxshilanishlar amalga oshirilganini, mavjud uskunalar ta'mirlanganini ta'kidlashga harakat qildi. Biroq, bu ota-onalar tomonidan juda kam, juda kech deb rad etildi.

Janob Jeyms ota-onalar bolalari xavfsiz va qiziqarli o'ynash joylari bo'lishi uchun nima kerakligini aniq aytib bo'lguncha mutlaqo charchagan edi. U juda ko'p qaydlar oldi va shuningdek, bu mavzu bo'yicha keyingi yig'ilishda qatnashmaslik haqida ruhiy eslatma qildi. U o'rinbosarini yuboradi.

mock_data.translationB1:
Shahar hokimiyati binosi gʻazablangan ota-onalar bilan toʻlib-toshgan edi. Ular shaharning bogʻlari va oʻyin maydonlari uchun masʼul boʻlgan maslahatchi janob Jeymsni kutishardi. Ota-onalar boshqa maslahatchilar ham kelishiga umid qilishgan edi, lekin janob Jeyms yagona kelgan odam edi. Boshqa maslahatchilar ishtirok etmadi.

Ota-onalar shahardagi yaxshi oʻyin maydonlarining yoʻqligidan xavotirda edilar. Ular kengashdan bu borada biror narsa qilishni xohlashardi. Janob Jeyms yaxshi notiq ekanligi bilan tanilgan, ammo ota-onalar u shunchaki chiroyli soʻzlar bilan cheklanib qolmasligiga qattiq qaror qilgan edilar. Ular shunchaki va'dalar emas, balki haqiqiy harakatni xohlashardi.

Janob Jeyms kelganida, ota-onalar kutganidek, juda doʻstona boʻlishni boshladi. Uning kengash a'zolari bolalar va ularning farovonligi haqida qanchalik qaygʻurayotgani haqida tayyor nutqi bor edi. U uni oʻqishni boshladi. Ammo u chinakamiga boshlashidan oldin, bir odam uni toʻxtatdi. Odam unga tezroq asosiy mavzuga oʻtishni aytdi. Janob Jeyms bundan hayratda qoldi, lekin boshqa ota-onalar ham bu odamga qoʻshilishdi.

Ota-onalar kengash hech narsa qilmagani uchun allaqachon gʻazablangan edilar. Janob Jeymsning chiroyli soʻzlari ularni faqat yanada gʻazablantirar edi. Janob Jeyms ota-onalarni qoniqtirish qiyin boʻlishini bilardi, ammo bu u oʻylagandan ham yomonroq edi.

Ularning koʻpchiligi yillar davomida yaxshiroq oʻyin maydonlariga erishishga harakat qilishgan. Ular janob Jeymsga qanchalik norozi ekanliklarini aytishga intiq edilar. Janob Jeyms ular ba'zi eski jihozlarni tuzatish kabi kichik oʻzgarishlar qilganliklarini aytishga harakat qildi. Ammo ota-onalar bu yetarli emasligini va juda koʻp vaqt ketganini aytishdi.

Janob Jeyms ota-onalar farzandlari uchun oʻyin maydonlarida nimalarni xohlashlarini aniq aytganlaridan keyin juda charchadi. U koʻplab yozuvlar qildi. U, shuningdek, bu haqdagi keyingi yigʻilishga bormaslikka qaror qildi. U oʻrniga oʻz yordamchisini joʻnatadi. Ota-onalar kengashdan chora koʻrishni va vaziyatni yaxshilashni xohlashadi.
mock_data.translationB2:
Shahar hokimiyati zali gʻazablangan ota-onalar bilan liqlikka toʻlgan edi, ularning barchasi shahar koʻngilochar hududlari uchun masʼul boʻlgan deputat janob Jeymsni kutishardi. Ular koʻproq deputatlar kelishiga umid qilishgan edi, lekin janob Jeyms yolgʻiz keldi, qolganlar koʻzga tashlanarli darajada yoʻq edi. Ota-onalar munosib oʻyin maydonchalarining yoʻqligidan juda norozi edilar va qandaydir chora koʻrilishini koʻrishga qaror qilishdi.

Janob Jeyms oʻzining ishontirish uslubi bilan tanilgan edi, lekin ota-onalar quruq vaʼdalar bilan aldanishga qaror qilishdi. Ular nafaqat soʻzlar, balki natijalarni kutishlarini aniq koʻrsatmoqchi edilar. Ular uzoq vaqtdan beri yaxshiroq sharoitlar uchun kurash olib borishgan edi.

Kutilganidek, janob Jeyms zalga kirishi bilan ularni oʻzining jozibasi bilan oʻziga ogʻdirib olishga harakat qildi. U kengash shahar bolalarini va ularning farovonligini qanchalik qadrlashi haqida tayyorlangan nutqni oʻqiy boshladi. Biroq, u tezda ota-onalardan biri tomonidan toʻxtatildi, u aniq ifodalarda unga maqsadga oʻtishni aytdi. Janob Jeyms bu odamning toʻgʻriligidan hayratda qoldi, lekin boshqa ota-onalar aniq aralashuvchini qoʻllab-quvvatladi. Ularning kengashning harakatsizligiga sabrlari tugagan edi va janob Jeymsning shirin soʻzlari vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirdi.

Janob Jeyms qiyin auditoriyani kutgan edi, lekin vaziyat u tasavvur qilganidan ham qiyinroq edi. Ota-onalarning koʻpchiligi yillar davomida oʻyin maydonchalarini yaxshilashga harakat qilishgan va oʻzlarining noroziliklarini bildirishga qaror qilishgan edi. Janob Jeyms mavjud uskunalar taʼmirlanganligini taʼkidlashga harakat qildi. Biroq, ota-onalar buni yetarli emas va kechiktirilgan deb hisoblashdi. Ular oʻzlarini bahonalar bilan aldanayotgandek his qilishdi.

Ota-onalar bolalari uchun xavfsiz va qiziqarli oʻyin maydonchalarini yaratish uchun nima qilish kerakligini aniq tushuntirib boʻlgach, janob Jeyms butunlay holdan toygan edi. U batafsil yozuvlar oldi va yashirincha oʻzining oʻrinbosarini bu mavzu boʻyicha keyingi yigʻilishga yuborishga qaror qildi. U gʻazab darajasidan va shikoyatlarning hadeganda koʻpligidan butunlay eshilib ketgan edi.
mock_data.translationC1:
Shahar hokimligi zali gʻazab bilan toʻlib-toshgan edi, ota-onalar sabr-toqat tugab borayotgan bir paytda shaharning dam olish maskanlariga mas’ul boʻlgan deputat janob Jeymsning kelishini kutishardi. Uning hamkasblarining koʻzga tashlanarli darajada yoʻqligi, ota-onalarning tashvishlariga e’tibor berilmayotgani haqidagi tasavvurini yanada kuchaytirib, vaziyatni yanada ogʻirlashtirdi.

Ularning noroziligi, oʻyin maydonchalari bilan juda yetarli darajada ta’minlanmaganligi, qaynash nuqtasiga yetgan edi. Janob Jeyms, tili shirinligi bilan tanilgan, oddiy ritorika bilan ularning noroziligini bosishi dargumon edi. Ota-onalar bu uchrashuv oddiy va’dalardan ustun boʻlishiga qattiq ishonishardi; ular amaliy harakatning zarurligini ta’kidlamoqchi edilar.

Kutilganidek, janob Jeyms zalga kirishi bilan toʻliq joziba hujumini boshladi. Odatdagidek, u oldindan tayyorlangan nutqini boshladi, goʻyoki kengashning shahar bolalariga va ularning farovonligiga sodiqligi haqida koʻp gapirdi. Biroq, u oʻz ohangini topishga ulgurmasidanoq, bir norozi ovoz, maqtanchoqlikni kesib oʻtib, uni xushomadgoʻylikni yigʻishtirib, asosiy muammoga e’tibor qaratishni talab qildi. Janob Jeyms, oʻzining beodoblik deb bilganidan aniq hayratda qolib, ota-onalarning birgalikdagi norozilik frontiga duch keldi.

Ularning ichida qaynab turgan gʻazabi janob Jeymsning qochirimliligi tufayli yanada kuchaydi. U qiyin auditoriyani kutgan edi, lekin ularning jamoaviy gʻazabining shiddati u kutganidan ham ortiqroq edi. Yaxshilangan va kengaytirilgan oʻyin maydonchalari uchun yillar davomida e’tiborga olinmagan iltimoslar toʻplanib qolgan gʻazablarini sochish uchun jamoaviy qat’iyatga aylandi.

Janob Jeymsning mavjud jihozlarni ta’mirlash kabi kichik yaxshilanishlarni ta’kidlashga urinishlari yetarli emas va kechiktirilgan deb rad etildi. Ota-onalarning talablari aniq edi: bolalari oʻynashi uchun xavfsiz, ragʻbatlantiruvchi joylar hashamat emas, balki zarurat edi. Ota-onalar oʻz talablarini bayon qilib boʻlganlarida, janob Jeyms butunlay holdan toygan edi. U ularning talablarini diqqat bilan qayd etdi va keyingi yigʻilishda oʻrinbosariga qatnashishni topshirishga qat’iy qaror qildi, aks holda u xuddi shu holatga duch keladi.
